metric_protocol.matching: maximum one-to-one original exclusive RGB bbox IoU>=0.50; exact Unicode casefold for OCR; punctuation retained
metric_protocol.ignore: only wholly invalid native source instances ignored; partially invalid instances kept whole; same identities across adapted branches
metric_protocol.crop: original RGB; pad0; no area filter or cap; oracle arms diagnostic only
metric_protocol.selection: minimum head TRAIN loss; no holdout threshold or checkpoint tuning
metric_protocol.validation: 125 repeatedly reused official TRAIN holdout images; not independent TEST
